items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I had E flat, I had E flat concert, what Parker gave me.

ctx.x: I had E flat, I know what would come with it. I had E flat, I had E flat concert, what Parker gave me. What did Parker gave you? Gave me. E flat concert, let me tell you that right now.
Did you ever play in any of those famous bands like Tuxedo?
